name: ash-desktop
description: Electron client for the Ash app-server protocol

scripts.prepare:generated: pnpm run typecheck:common && pnpm run icons:check
scripts.prepare:desktop: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --success all -n native,generated,backend "pnpm run rebuild:native" "pnpm run prepare:generated" "pnpm run prepare:backend"
scripts.prebuild: pnpm run rebuild:native && pnpm run prepare:generated
scripts.prebuild:host: pnpm run rebuild:native && pnpm run prepare:generated
scripts.predev:ui: pnpm run rebuild:native && pnpm run prepare:generated
scripts.predev:web:full: pnpm run prepare:generated && pnpm run prepare:backend:web
scripts.pretest:unit: pnpm run prepare:output && pnpm run prepare:generated
scripts.pretest:editor:unit: pnpm run prepare:output && pnpm run prepare:generated
scripts.test:main: pnpm run test:build-tools && pnpm run test:unit
scripts.test:extensions: node test/unit/clean.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.extensions-test.json && node test/unit/extensions.ts
scripts.test:unit: node test/unit/clean.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node test/unit/run.ts
scripts.test:editor:unit: node test/unit/clean.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node test/unit/editor.ts
scripts.test:editor: pnpm run test:editor:unit && pnpm run test:editor:browser
scripts.test:smoke:browser:debug: pnpm run pretest:smoke:browser && cross-env ASH_PLAYWRIGHT_SERVER=disconnected playwright test --project=browser-ui --debug
scripts.test:loading: cross-env ASH_LOADING_BASELINE=1 pnpm run test:smoke:browser:full --grep 'production loading baseline' --repeat-each=3
scripts.pretest:smoke:desktop: pnpm run prepare:backend && pnpm run build && tsc -p test/automation/tsconfig.json
scripts.pretest:app: pnpm run prepare:backend && pnpm run build && tsc -p test/automation/tsconfig.json
scripts.pretest:app:pdf-corpus: pnpm run prepare:backend && pnpm run build && tsc -p test/automation/tsconfig.json
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n renderer,electron-host,app-server "vite --config ../build/app_ts/vite/vite.config.ts" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env ASH_DEV_APP_SERVER_RELOAD=1 ASH_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 node ../build/app_ts/launch/electron.ts --watch" "node ../build/app_ts/watch-app-server.ts --skip-initial"
scripts.dev:ui: concurrently -k -n renderer,electron-host "vite --config ../build/app_ts/vite/vite.config.ts" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env ASH_DESKTOP_UI_ONLY=1 ASH_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 node ../build/app_ts/launch/electron.ts --watch"
scripts.dev:ui:connected: pnpm run predev:ui && concurrently -k -n renderer,electron-host "vite --config ../build/app_ts/vite/vite.config.ts" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env ASH_DEV_REUSE_APP_SERVER=1 ASH_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 node ../build/app_ts/launch/electron.ts --watch"
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env ASH_DEV_APP_SERVER_RELOAD=1 ASH_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 node ../build/app_ts/launch/electron.ts --watch
scripts.prestart: pnpm run prepare:output && pnpm run prepare:desktop
